scientific_integrity: The proof is analytic and addresses all spins and all angles. A separate finite checker tests rational identities and numerical samples without being treated as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only Haar-axis single-fixed-angle central probability measures on SO(3); exact L2 mean-zero operator contraction, not arbitrary angle mixtures or total-variation distance from a point. Classical character formula, no claim of independent priority certification.
title: The unique fastest fixed-angle isotropic random rotation walk on \(\mathrm{SO}(3)\)
